narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share an inspiring personal journey of how an obsession with video games (specifically Diablo II) led to the development of the 'Gamification' theory, which the guest used to transform his life and career, eventually becoming a successful entrepreneur. It aims to educate viewers on the concept of life-gamification.
